questions.stem: A frequency table shows: Value $0$ (freq $3$), Value $1$ (freq $5$), Value $2$ (freq $8$), Value $3$ (freq $4$). What is the median?
questions.explanation: Total frequency $= 20$. The median is between the $10$th and $11$th values. Cumulative frequencies: $3, 8, 16, 20$. The $10$th and $11$th values both fall in the 'Value $2$' group. So the median is $2$.

questions.stem: In a frequency table, what does the column $fx$ represent?

options.text: The frequency divided by the value
The frequency multiplied by the value

questions.explanation: $fx$ means the frequency ($f$) multiplied by the data value ($x$). The sum of the $fx$ column divided by the total frequency gives the mean.
